title: Comparison of the VerifyNow® Aspirin Test and PRUTest® Platelet Reactivity Tests With Investigational Reagent to Reagents Registered in Japan

sections.abstract: This is a multi-center convenience sample prospective study comparing the results of the Verify Now® Aspirin Test and PRUTest® Platelet Reactivity Tests with the Japan investigational reagents to reagents registered in Japan in the expected population receiving aspirin (ASA) and the P2Y12 inhibitor clopidogrel.
